name: AI Copilot V3 — M1 Schedule + Execute + File

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every 1 minute for testing. Change to cronExpression for production (e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5 = weekdays 9am).

nodes.name: Execute Pipeline Test
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT: n8n must be started from the project root for this path to resolve. Run: n8n start (from ai-data-copilot/). Output lands in $json.stdout — it is JSON because test_setup.py prints JSON.

nodes.name: Read Execution Log
nodes.notes: Reads the log file written by test_setup.py. Demonstrates the File node. Binary content is base64 — decode in next node if needed. Only works after at least one Execute run.

_notes.purpose: Milestone 1 — demonstrates Schedule Trigger, Execute Command, and File nodes
how_to_test: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Workflows > Import from File)
2. Open the workflow, click 'Test Workflow' or activate it
3. Check automation/logs/test_run.log — should see a JSON line per execution
4. In n8n execution view, check Execute Pipeline Test output — status should be OK or PARTIAL
